triage.fix_rationale: The vulnerable packages are transitive, so refreshing the lockfile with `npm audit fix` resolves them. package.json would only change if a direct dependency or an override needs a bump, for example vitest and its coverage package.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at --audit-level=high found 6 high-severity advisories in transitive packages (brace-expansion, browserslist, fast-uri, js-yaml, source-map-js, undici) that are locked at vulnerable versions in package-lock.json. All of them report a fix available via `npm audit fix`.
